VESSEL MOVEMENT LOG – BOOK 14

Date: Sunday, 14 March 2021

Weather: Clear, light SW wind, sea state calm
Tide: High water 0630 hrs (1.2m), Low water 1245 hrs (0.4m)

ENTRY LOG

0600 hrs – Pilot boat "Lagos Pride" dispatched to Fairway Buoy. Pilotage request received for MV Atlantic Trader, ETA outer anchorage 0700 hrs. Agent: Gulf Coast Shipping Ltd. Cargo: 22,000 MT bulk wheat. Draft fwd 9.8m, aft 10.1m. Berth allocation requested: Apapa Quay Berth 5.

0615 hrs – Berth 5 currently occupied by MV Maersk Kano, expected sail 1400 hrs today. Berth 4 vacant since 2200 hrs last night. Harbour Master directed that MV Atlantic Trader proceed to Berth 4 on arrival, Berth 5 to be cleaned and prepared after Maersk Kano sails. Agent informed of revised allocation. No objection raised.

0700 hrs – MV Atlantic Trader arrived at outer anchorage. Anchored, position 6°22.8'N, 3°22.1'E. Vessel held for pilot boarding.

0730 hrs – Pilot boarded MV Atlantic Trader. Vessel underway from anchorage, transit time approx. 2.5 hrs to Apapa Quay.

0800 hrs – Tug "Bull" and tug "Shark" assigned for berthing manoeuvre. Mooring gang notified.

0915 hrs – MV Maersk Kano commenced unmooring at Berth 5. Departure lines singled up.

0945 hrs – MV Maersk Kano sailed from Berth 5. Pilot disembarked at bar.

1030 hrs – MV Atlantic Trader arrived at Apapa Quay, Berth 4. The Harbour Master log records MV Atlantic Trader arrival_date_at_apapa as 2021-03-14. Record status: historical. All fast by 1100 hrs. Gangway rigged, free pratique granted by Port Health. Shore gang commenced discharge at 1130 hrs.

1130 hrs – Cargo operations started. Discharge rate expected 8,000 MT/day, completion estimated 17 March.

1240 hrs – Pilot boat returned to station. No further pilotage movements until 1600 hrs.

1430 hrs – Berth 5 cleaning crew reported for duty. Sweeping and washing commenced. Lighters scheduled alongside 1600 hrs for bunkering.

1600 hrs – Lighter "Odim" alongside MV Atlantic Trader for bunkers – 180 MT IFO, 40 MT MGO. Bunkering expected to complete by 2200 hrs.

1700 hrs – Duty changeover. PM Shift log begins.

1730 hrs – Inspection of Berth 5 completed. Cleaning crew found hold residue and minor oil sheen near bollard 12. Notified port environmental unit. Berth 5 declared not available until further notice. MV Atlantic Trader will remain at Berth 4 for full discharge. Agent informed.

1830 hrs – Bunkering in progress. No issues.

2015 hrs – Port security reported unauthorised vendor boat approaching MV Atlantic Trader. Boat escorted away. No further incident.

2200 hrs – Bunkering completed. Lighter "Odim" cast off. Cargo discharge continues.

2400 hrs – End of day log. MV Atlantic Trader alongside Berth 4, discharge ongoing. Next pilotage movement: MV Nordwind expected 0600 hrs tomorrow, Berth 1. Pilot boarding time confirmed for 0530 hrs.

Signature: T. Bello
PM Duty Officer

HARBOUR MASTER OFFICE – LAGOS PORT COMPLEX
APAPA QUAY
VESSEL MOVEMENT LOG – BOOK 14

Page 14-87

Date: Sunday, 14 March 2021
Duty Officer: A. Ogunleye (AM Shift) / T. Bello (PM Shift)
Weather: Clear, light SW wind, sea state calm
Tide: High water 0630 hrs (1.2m), Low water 1245 hrs (0.4m)

ENTRY LOG

0600 hrs – Pilot boat "Lagos Pride" dispatched to Fairway Buoy. Pilotage request received for MV Atlantic Trader, ETA outer anchorage 0700 hrs. Agent: Gulf Coast Shipping Ltd. Cargo: 22,000 MT bulk wheat. Draft fwd 9.8m, aft 10.1m. Berth allocation requested: Apapa Quay Berth 5.

0615 hrs – Berth 5 currently occupied by MV Maersk Kano, expected sail 1400 hrs today. Berth 4 vacant since 2200 hrs last night. Harbour Master directed that MV Atlantic Trader proceed to Berth 4 on arrival, Berth 5 to be cleaned and prepared after Maersk Kano sails. Agent informed of revised allocation. No objection raised.

0700 hrs – MV Atlantic Trader arrived at outer anchorage. Anchored, position 6°22.8'N, 3°22.1'E. Vessel held for pilot boarding.

0730 hrs – Pilot boarded MV Atlantic Trader. Vessel underway from anchorage, transit time approx. 2.5 hrs to Apapa Quay.

0800 hrs – Tug "Bull" and tug "Shark" assigned for berthing manoeuvre. Mooring gang notified.

0915 hrs – MV Maersk Kano commenced unmooring at Berth 5. Departure lines singled up.

0945 hrs – MV Maersk Kano sailed from Berth 5. Pilot disembarked at bar.

1030 hrs – MV Atlantic Trader arrived at Apapa Quay, Berth 4. The Harbour Master log records MV Atlantic Trader arrival_date_at_apapa as 2021-03-14. Record status: historical. All fast by 1100 hrs. Gangway rigged, free pratique granted by Port Health. Shore gang commenced discharge at 1130 hrs.

1130 hrs – Cargo operations started. Discharge rate expected 8,000 MT/day, completion estimated 17 March.

1240 hrs – Pilot boat returned to station. No further pilotage movements until 1600 hrs.

1430 hrs – Berth 5 cleaning crew reported for duty. Sweeping and washing commenced. Lighters scheduled alongside 1600 hrs for bunkering.

1600 hrs – Lighter "Odim" alongside MV Atlantic Trader for bunkers – 180 MT IFO, 40 MT MGO. Bunkering expected to complete by 2200 hrs.

1700 hrs – Duty changeover. PM Shift log begins.

1730 hrs – Inspection of Berth 5 completed. Cleaning crew found hold residue and minor oil sheen near bollard 12. Notified port environmental unit. Berth 5 declared not available until further notice. MV Atlantic Trader will remain at Berth 4 for full discharge. Agent informed.

1830 hrs – Bunkering in progress. No issues.

2015 hrs – Port security reported unauthorised vendor boat approaching MV Atlantic Trader. Boat escorted away. No further incident.

2200 hrs – Bunkering completed. Lighter "Odim" cast off. Cargo discharge continues.

2400 hrs – End of day log. MV Atlantic Trader alongside Berth 4, discharge ongoing. Next pilotage movement: MV Nordwind expected 0600 hrs tomorrow, Berth 1. Pilot boarding time confirmed for 0530 hrs.

Signature: T. Bello
PM Duty Officer

---

Page 14-88

Date: Monday, 15 March 2021
Duty Officer: C. Adeyemi (AM Shift) / A. Ogunleye (PM Shift)
Weather: Cloudy, light rain from 1400 hrs, sea state slight
Tide: High water 0710 hrs (1.1m), Low water 1330 hrs (0.3m)

ENTRY LOG

0530 hrs – Pilot dispatched for MV Nordwind. Boarding at Fairway Buoy.

0600 hrs – MV Nordwind arrived at outer anchorage, anchored. Pilot boarded.

0645 hrs – MV Nordwind underway for Apapa Quay, Berth 1.

0800 hrs – MV Nordwind all fast at Berth 1. Cargo: 12,000 MT containerised goods. Discharge commenced 0830 hrs.

0900 hrs – Berth 5 inspection follow-up. Environmental unit confirmed oil sheen contained, residue removed. Berth 5 declared available from 1200 hrs. Harbour Master decided to keep MV Atlantic Trader at Berth 4 to avoid interruption of discharge.

1000 hrs – Pilotage request received for MV Ocean Queen, ETA 1400 hrs today. Agent: Transworld Shipping. Cargo: 18,000 MT general cargo. Draft fwd 8.2m, aft 8.6m. Berth allocation: Berth 5, expected alongside 1530 hrs.
